message:
♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.5.2 IS LIVE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**Force Preview** now checks its own work, and the stuttering **"zombie" audio** is gone.

*(Install over your current version and restart After Effects once.)*

♦️ **New: No zombie audio** (FX & ADV RIGS > Force Preview Render)
* When a preview cannot keep up, After Effects plays the sound in broken pieces. Now it stays silent until the preview is in real time, then plays clean sound.
* On by default. It is After Effects' own setting (Mute Audio When Preview Is Not Real-time), so it works for every Space preview. Switch it off in the Force Preview window.

♦️ **New: Force Preview checks the cache** (engine 1.4.0)
* After the last frame it goes through the range again and renders any frame that dropped out of the cache, before it says READY TO PLAY.
* Fixes "it said done, but the first seconds still stutter".
* When After Effects cannot hold every frame, it says about how many do not fit and why.
* **Update the engine:** open Force Preview Render, press **UPDATE ENGINE**, restart After Effects.

♦️ **New: Disk space warning**
* After Effects stops saving preview frames when the cache drive is nearly full (10 GB free by default). The Recommended card now warns you before that happens.

♦️ **Good to know**
* With little free memory, a cached preview can still drop below real time for a moment: you hear a short silence, not stutter.
